definitions: To spend time idly or unproductively; to waste time.
To behave in a silly or playful way.
To be involved in a casual sexual relationship.
To tamper with or make minor adjustments to something.
examples: Stop messing around and get to work.
The kids were messing around in the park.
He's been messing around with his ex-girlfriend again.
Don't mess around with the settings on the computer.
